   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 6, 2026 - Aug 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Yaroslav Prt_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "* was good ui, with circle time picker and category, now it some buggy horizontal scroll * sounds can't be turned off in settings * to start need press one button, after finish need make 3? 5? clicks, with long as hell obsolete animation"
            2. _Prerona (Sol)_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "Love the concept of this app, especially how it blocks access to other apps, but it is extremely glitchy and often crashes in the middle of my focus sessions, and when that happens it doesn't register any of the focus time I was doing. Also I wish there was a way to plant real trees without getting premium, like if we could purchase a real tree with our coins or time crystals. I will keep using the app despite the bugs because it really is great for helping me focus."
            3. _Keith Gold_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "They recently updated the UI, this is how I know they do not use the app themselves, if it’s not broken why change it, please change the app to how it was before this terrible upgrade"
